thread:
Cara: Quick follow-up from the cache-thundering postmortem — we need owners to update the runbook and playbook. Focus: triage steps (commands), escalation path, and a short mitigation play for cache stampedes. Can owners volunteer and give rough ETA?
RemyBot: Postmortem doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/cache-thunder-2026 (summary + actions) :white_check_mark:
Mike: I can take triage steps + CLI snippets. 3 days ok?
Jordan: I’ll own escalation path and on-call contact updates. 1 week for doc + pages.
Sophia: I’ll handle the cache-prewarm mitigation notes and add a short test plan. aiming for 2w for implementation.
Priya: I can draft the customer-facing incident template and status-message snippets. 2 days.
Mike: Proposed quick triage snippet to add to runbook (please sanity-check):
```
# check runtime logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=200
# get gpu utilization (if applicable)
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv -l 5
# inspect KV cache hit/miss metrics (prometheus)
curl -s "http://prom/prom/api/v1/query?query=cache_hits_total" | jq .
# restart runtime pods if stuck
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/runtime-service
```
Jordan: For escalation, recommend: page SRE primary on-call if 95th p99 latency > 250ms for 5m OR error-rate > 1% for 3m. Add step to escalate to Eng-Platform lead if no ack in 15m. Also add a fallback to model-variant routing.
Sophia: Noted. Also we should add an explicit prewarm step: after cache flush, call prewarm lambda with common prefixes. Example API call to enqueue prewarm:
```
POST https://edge.internal/prewarm
Body: { "prefixes": ["/v1/resp/", "/embed/"], "batch": 100 }
```
Priya: For customer comms, two templates: "Investigating — degraded performance" and "Mitigated — continuing monitoring". I'll add variables for region, impacted endpoints, and ETA.
Mike: Small addition: add a canary fallback command to route X% traffic to smaller model variant when backend saturated. Pseudo: `redwood route set --from runtime-model:latest --to runtime-model:small --percent 20` — this should be in the mitigation section.
Jordan: Also add an ownership matrix in the runbook header: triage (Mike), escalation (Jordan), mitigations (Sophia), comms (Priya). Put links to on-call rotation and PagerDuty play.
Cara: OK — let's capture as action items here. Please add checklist items to the postmortem doc and assign owners in GH issues. I'll follow up in 48 hours.
Cara: Actions summary (add to PM doc):
- [ ] Mike: Update runbook triage commands + examples (due 3d)
- [ ] Jordan: Update escalation path + paging rules + doc links (due 7d)
- [ ] Sophia: Add cache prewarm + eviction mitigation + test plan (due 14d)
- [ ] Priya: Add customer status templates + variables (due 2d)
- [ ] Mike & Jordan: Add canary fallback step + traffic routing example (due 5d)
Mike: I’ll open the GH PR for triage commands this afternoon and link it here.
Jordan: I’ll update PagerDuty rules and send the rotation link to the runbook.
Sophia: I’ll sketch the prewarm lambda test plan and drop into the doc under "Mitigations" tomorrow.
RemyBot: Reminder set: follow-up ping in 48 hours.
Cara: Thanks team — if anyone hits blockers, call me or DM. :eyes:
Priya: Quick Q — do we want to add a recurring quarterly review for runbooks (to catch patterns)? Suggest `recurring: quarterly` in the header.
Jordan: yes — add quarterly review + link to the incidents digest so we can catch recurring patterns across postmortems.
Cara: Done. I’ll create the GH issues and assign. Closing this thread for async updates — keep edits in the postmortem doc rather than here. :white_check_mark:
